    spaceState = None; query = None; shape = None; freePos = None; initialCollisions = None; tries = None; collisions = None
    spaceState = _item.get_world_2d().get_direct_space_state()
    query = Physics2DShapeQueryParameters.new()
    shape = None

        shape = _item.collisionShape.shape
    else:

    if _item.ownerType == Owner.Title:

    query.exclude = [_item]
    query.transform.origin = startPos
    freePos = startPos
    initialCollisions = spaceState.collide_shape(query, 1)
    if (not initialCollisions):
        return freePos
    
    tries = 0
    
    for _item.offset in _range_or_value([20, 40, 70, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 500, 600]):
        for angle in _range_or_value(range(_item.angleStep, 360 + _item.angleStep, _item.angleStep)):
            freePos = startPos + (Vector2.UP * _item.offset).rotated(_item.deg2rad(angle))
            query.transform.origin = freePos
            collisions = spaceState.collide_shape(query, 1)
    
            tries += 1
            if (not collisions):
    
                return freePos
    
    
    return freePos
